_comment: request-pipeline/08-planning.md + episode-lifecycle.md — the plan_progress meta-tool. A task-shaped message opens an episode (episode_id set on ModelCallInput), but one obscure enough that SkillDiscover matches no seed -> ComposeSkill never runs -> turn_plan is never auto-seeded. That isolates the fixture-path append handling: ModelCall.split_progress_calls peels plan_progress out of the tool stream, plan.apply_progress applies it against episode_id — appending a new checkpoint when the id is unknown + an intent is given, updating status when it exists. Exercises done / skipped / (implicit) active across three steps.
